notes.title: The update is just around the corner!
notes.content:
The version 1.6.0 update will be released on August 15th.
This update includes:

- Character design during dialogues
- 4 episodes (1 long and 3 short)

notes.title: Update Releases
notes.content:
The next update is on August 10th. From that date, updates will be released every 5-7 days. The update will include:

[b]Two episodes for the Abyss side[/b]
